items.evidence: SCOPE: save-loading. The 26.1.2 delta REMOVED BlockState::from_palette_nbt from crates/horizon-world/src/chunk.rs (0 hits in 26.1.2 vs 6 in 26.1.1's: def :215, call sites :355/:373/:456, test :800-801). All three call sites now use strict from_nbt (chunk.rs:341 ChunkData::block, :359 set_block, :442 BlockSection::from_nbt), which errors 'block state is missing id' on a compound without id. Vanilla 26.1.2 still writes Name/Properties palettes — PROVEN in the reference world (vanilla-world-mc 26.1.2, seed 4656297851632877335, DataVersion 4790): palette key-shapes ('Name',) and ('Name', 'Properties'). The rename to id is datafix key 5006 (fixes_c.rs:155-159), a LATER version's fix: update() runs fixes only where k/10 <= to_version (datafix/mod.rs:223) and CURRENT = 4790, so 5006 never runs; and a vanilla 26.1.2 world at DataVersion 4790 runs NO datafix at all (upgrade_record early-returns, save.rs:2452). Load path: save.load (:2880) -> decode_column (:1756) -> registry.saved_state_id (registry.rs:230-241, BlockState::from_nbt(tag).ok()) -> None -> mapped to AIR (save.rs:1799 map_or(air,...)). Consequence: every block in a vanilla-written 26.1.2 world loads as air (world loads as void). Port-written saves still load (port's own to_nbt writes id, chunk.rs:192-207). 26.3 comparison: 26.3's reference world writes BARE STRINGS and ('id', 'properties') compounds — the strict reader is 26.3-correct, 26.1.2-wrong. CI corroboration (run 45150986405): datafix::tests::block_states_take_their_new_field_names FAILED and save::tests::older_records_of_a_current_world_upgrade_as_they_are_read FAILED (plus two neighbouring save-upgrade tests) — the tree's own tests assert the id form the upgrade code cannot produce. Flagged but NOT minted by Batches 5 and 6.

systemic_note: Three systemic causes recur, all inherited unchanged from 26.1.1 (measured by file-by-file tree diff — every defect-bearing Rust file in scope is byte-identical to 26.1.1's). (1) Class-table: 4 of 1.21.7's 9 renames carry to 26.1.2 with live arms dead — AbstractBed (B11-G01), RedstoneWire (B11-G02), Path (B11-G03), Speleothem (B11-G04) — all four 26.3 names present in the 26.3 jar and absent from both 26.1.2 jars; classes.rs is 0-diff vs 26.1.1's, still with NO dual names. Group B (StrawBed, SulfurSpike, ShelfMushroom, PotentSulfur) is 26.2/26.3-only content, harmless. (2) Tags/components: 26.1.2 HAS the 26.x tags the port reads (cauldron wash, chorus, mushroom light, snow-layer, convertable_to_mud all live in 26.1.2 data), so most of 1.21.7's tag-degradation defects do not apply; the two exceptions are 26.3-only tags the port reads — the potion tags (B11-G05) and speleothems (second cause of B11-G04). The component form is NEW and worse: the tree reads cooking_fuel/brewing_fuel/compostable/villager_food/mob_visibility components 26.1.2 vanilla never defines (B11-G07's empty fuel list; Batch 4's B4-G01 furnaces, B4-G02 brewing, Batch 5's B5-G22 composter), where the 26.1 tree had restored the hardcoded tables. (3) F3: the spawn-counts abbreviations remain the 26.2+ form (B11-G09). NEW vs 26.1.1: the delta itself introduced two regressions — the palette reader now accepts only the post-5006 id form while vanilla 26.1.2 writes Name/Properties palettes, so vanilla-written worlds load as void (B11-G10, major, save-loading), and 26.1.1's PlayerEntry fix was dropped (B11-G11, minor, uncalled code). RE-BASE WARNING: 26.1.2 is 26.x where 1.21.7 is not in eleven verified behaviours (trident passenger check, SwellGoal alive check, polar-bear fox age gate, lead-knot discard, mushroom/sapling bonemeal gates, golem stroll roll order, social gate, trader heightmap + SavedData storage, shipwreck heightAdjusted, players/data layout) — do not propagate 1.21.7 forms to 26.1.2. The 1e-5 fluid floor is present in both 26.1.2 vanilla (Entity constant pool) and the Rust. Four 26.1.2-vs-26.2 cautions: 26.1.2's F3 Mood literal is ONE-spaced while 26.2's is TWO-spaced, 26.1.2's spawn-counts abbreviations are single letters while 26.2's are two/three, 26.1.2 vanilla HAS sound variants for cows/pigs/chickens/cats (1.21.7's A02 never existed here), and 26.1.2 has NO cooking_fuel/brewing_fuel/compostable/villager_food components — do not propagate 26.3 component forms down. Fifth, NEW: 26.1.2 writes Name/Properties chunk palettes — do not propagate the post-5006 id reader down (B11-G10).
